description: 2 calls. Runs the official CEN EN 16931 business rules (validation artefacts, unmodified) on a UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII (also the XML inside Factur-X/ZUGFeRD). Returns VALID/INVALID, each failed rule id with where it fails and how to fix it. XML is checked in memory, not stored. Example: {"xml":"<Invoice xmlns=...>...complete document...</Invoice>"}.

ruleset.description: Optional; auto detects UBL vs CII.

xml.description: The complete invoice XML document as text.

name: einvoice_check
title: Validate an e-invoice (EN 16931)
